searchText: Are there ePBS breakout/meetings? Doesn't seem to be in shared calendar It was removed because both Teku and Prysm stopped developing after a minimal interop. Perhaps we could move to a more regular cadence soon. We have one scheduled for Friday though: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1659 is there a reason this breakout call can't just be ACDT since ePBS is SFI-ed? unless ofc there's a lot to discuss. we had ACDT + peerdas breakouts until relatively recently as well. It's probably fine although 1) probably there's very little to report still on ePBS and 2) I teach at acdt time and can never make it 😅 yeah then a breakout probably does make more sense if you cant make it to acdt Nah, just kidding. There's no reason for me to be in all meetings. I can watch the recording I assume lots to discuss; and not everyone on ACDT necessarily interested on the minutiae of a Glamsterdam feature at this time? But seriously acdt happens weekly and there's little to report now Yeah agreed, it'll always be waves - soon we start off with more glamsterdam work and we'll have a ton to discuss again Somehow calendar update was skipped by the ACD bot. The meeting should be visible on the Ethereum Protocol Calendar now.

excerpts.content: Are there ePBS breakout/meetings? Doesn't seem to be in shared calendar

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: It was removed because both Teku and Prysm stopped developing after a minimal interop. Perhaps we could move to a more regular cadence soon. We have one scheduled for Friday though:

excerpts.content: is there a reason this breakout call can't just be ACDT since ePBS is SFI-ed? unless ofc there's a lot to discuss. we had ACDT + peerdas breakouts until relatively recently as well.

excerpts.content: It's probably fine although 1) probably there's very little to report still on ePBS and 2) I teach at acdt time and can never make it 😅

excerpts.content: yeah then a breakout probably does make more sense if you cant make it to acdt

excerpts.content: Yeah agreed, it'll always be waves - soon we start off with more glamsterdam work and we'll have a ton to discuss again
